name: Prelulu
summary: Free-to-start app for text, voice and live video calls with AI characters you can pick or create.
description: Prelulu is a consumer app for chatting, calling and live video-calling original AI characters, including ones you create, with conversation memory that carries between text and calls. Official web pricing: a daily free text-message allowance forever, plus welcome and check-in credits that can fund a short call. In-app store prices are higher because of store fees.

pricing.details: Daily free text allowance; Plus 9 €/month, Premium 27 €/month, Muse 89 €/month on the web (yearly promo 5 € / 16 € / 54 €).
